rubric.role_summary: Senior property-management operations role based in Berlin, integrating newly acquired German property-management offices into operating processes and software workflows through on-site work across Germany.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior property-management operations role based in Berlin, integrating newly acquired German property-management offices into operating processes and software workflows through on-site work across Germany.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Multiple years of practical property-management experience, with independent command of day-to-day operations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Berlin, Germany area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

must_haves.requirement: Multiple years of practical property-management experience, with independent command of day-to-day operations.
must_haves.source_quote: Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt.
Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

soft_requirements: Recognizes problems quickly, prioritizes, and takes a hands-on approach.
Communicates clearly, builds trust quickly, and helps people adopt new ways of working.
Is comfortable with technology, learns new software quickly, and explains it effectively to others.

location.reason: The Berlin office is the base; site visits across Germany are travel, not residence.
